answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the ferrous of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The spiral lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the dawn is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
